command:
cmake --build --preset windows-msvc-x64-debug --target ForgeConductor.Contracts.ContractTests ForgeConductor.Mcp.CatalogCodecTests ForgeConductor.Mcp.StdioTransportTests ForgeConductor.Mcp.ProtocolServerTests -- /m
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
ctest --preset windows-msvc-x64-debug -R "^(ForgeConductor\.Mcp\.(CatalogCodec|StdioTransport|ProtocolServer)Tests|ForgeConductor\.(Contracts|NativeTools)\.ContractTests)$" --output-on-failure
exit $LASTEXITCODE
